verdict.rationale: Company formation is a fair question for a full-service law firm, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows the firm offers incorporation work: no charter or articles drafting, no bylaws, no initial board resolutions, no founder share subscription, and no dedicated startup or emerging-companies practice. The material that does exist only names start-ups as one client type and covers other topics (the 2026 Startup Notification, ESOP tax, PE, M&A, funds), none of which evidences formation services.
